title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
prompt: You are given an array points representing integer coordinates of some points on a 2D-plane, where points[i] = [xi, yi]. The cost of connecting two points [xi, yi] and [xj, yj] is the manhattan distance: |xi - xj| + |yi - yj|. Return the minimum cost to make all points connected. All points are connected if there is exactly one simple path between any two points.
hints: Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). Prim's or Kruskal's. Prim: start at one node, repeatedly add cheapest edge to unvisited node.
Prim with min-heap: (cost, node). For each node, add edges to all others. Pop min, if unvisited add cost and add its edges.
O(n^2) edges. Prim with adjacency: O(n^2) time. Can optimize with distance array.
